## Testing

- [ ] `npm.cmd run lint`
- [ ] `npm.cmd run build`
- [ ] `npm.cmd run qa:preview-export` when image processing, preview, export, or browser workflows changed

## Local-first checklist

- [ ] Source images stay local to the browser session
- [ ] Generated files, caches, screenshots, model blobs, and temporary exports are not committed
- [ ] D-drive storage rules are preserved for local scripts and artifacts
- [ ] AGPL-3.0-or-later posture is preserved
